caption: The drawing features a single large object centered within a rectangular frame, rendered in shades of black and gray on an off-white background. The object depicted is a funnel with a wide, flared mouth tapering smoothly down into a narrow spout. The funnel is shown at an angle pointing from the upper right to the lower left corner. Two prominent ridges encircle the funnel’s body near the wider end, providing structural details. Shading is applied throughout the funnel to indicate curvature and depth. In the lower center of the drawing, there is an inset diagram displaying a side view cross-section of the funnel with handwritten measurements: the diameter of the mouth is marked as 7 inches, the height of the funnel is marked as 5 3/4 inches, and the length of the spout section is noted as 2 1/4 inches. The bottom right of the drawing is labeled with the name "CHARLES GARJAN." The entire composition is bordered by a thin rectangular outline.
title: Funnel
